about.label: About SRK
about.heading: About Sustainable Resources of Kenya
paragraphs: Sustainable Resources of Kenya (SRK) is a Kenyan non-governmental organization committed to empowering communities to build sustainable livelihoods, protect natural resources, and become resilient agents of their own development.
SRK works with communities and strategic partners to develop practical solutions to social, economic, and environmental challenges affecting vulnerable and underserved populations across Kenya.

SRK believes that lasting development happens when communities are not simply recipients of solutions but are actively involved in identifying their challenges, developing solutions, managing resources, and shaping their own future.
about.quoteIntro: Our work is built around a simple principle:
about.quote: Strong communities are the foundation of a sustainable future.

cards.title: Sustainable Livelihoods & Food Security

cards.title: Environment, Climate Action & Natural Resources
cards.description: Our goal is to help communities respond to environmental challenges while protecting the resources upon which their livelihoods depend.

cards.title: Water, Sanitation & Community Infrastructure
